title: Fit a conversational workload inside serving headroom
description: Change request volume, context length, response length, worker count, and model tier. The values are illustrative planning assumptions, not disclosed OpenAI pricing or fleet data.

tiers.label: Fast tier
tiers.detail: Low-cost, high-throughput route for classification, rewriting, and straightforward chat turns.

tiers.label: Balanced tier
tiers.detail: General-purpose route with more quality headroom and lower serving throughput per worker.

tiers.label: Reasoning tier
tiers.detail: Expensive, capacity-limited route reserved for tasks where extra deliberation changes the result.
